title: Mofka in Workflow Provenance
prose: HPC workflows increasingly require provenance tracking to enable reproducibility, debugging, and audit. Mofka's persistent event-streaming model provides a natural substrate: workflow events can be published to Mofka topics and consumed asynchronously by provenance collectors without blocking the primary computation [ref:SEED]. An LLM-based interactive provenance system cites Mofka as a candidate HPC-optimized broker for provenance message transport, noting its RDMA-optimized transport makes it well-suited to tightly coupled HPC networks [ref:W4416004498].
